faqs.question: Are the rates on this rate card fixed or negotiable for long-term contracts?
faqs.answer: The rates presented are our benchmark corporate tariffs. For long-term 12-month or multi-year Master Services Agreements (MSAs), our commercial team configures custom volume discounts up to 15% based on committed fleet size and shift route predictability.

faqs.question: What is included in the monthly dedicated vehicle retainer packages?
faqs.answer: Monthly retainers cover 26 operational days per calendar month with a committed kilometre allowance (typically 2,600 km). Fuel, chauffeur salary, insurance, and routine servicing are fully included. Additional kilometres and hours are billed at contracted marginal rates.

faqs.question: How are Fastag highway tolls and airport parking fees accounted for?
faqs.answer: All tolls and parking are tracked automatically via Fastag electronic transaction IDs and physical gate receipts. They are itemized line-by-line on your fortnightly or monthly billing dossier without manual markup.

faqs.question: Can our company onboard under 30-day net credit terms immediately?
faqs.answer: Yes. Following standard vendor compliance check (GSTIN verification, PAN, and signed Master Services Agreement), enterprise accounts are granted 30-day net credit terms with fortnightly or monthly consolidated electronic invoices.

faqs.question: How do Salik toll charges get billed for Dubai and Abu Dhabi journeys?
faqs.answer: Each Salik toll gate is automatically captured through RTA electronic transponders at AED 4 per gate. They are itemized on your monthly invoice with timestamp, gate name, and vehicle plate number.

faqs.question: Are inter-emirate transit trips between Dubai and Abu Dhabi charged standard rates?
faqs.answer: Inter-emirate trips between Dubai and Abu Dhabi are billed based on our transparent outstation tariff or fixed corridor packages, which include fuel and chauffeur services. Salik and Darb tolls are added at actual cost.

faqs.question: What is the procedure for setting up an enterprise monthly limousine retainer?
faqs.answer: Corporate entities registered in the UAE provide their Trade License and TRN certificate. We execute a standard Master Services Agreement (MSA) granting 30-day net credit terms and assigning dedicated luxury vehicles with professional chauffeurs.

faqs.question: Can we hire vehicles for multi-day international delegations and exhibitions?
faqs.answer: Yes. We specialize in multi-vehicle delegation convoys for events at Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC), Expo City Dubai, and ADNEC Abu Dhabi with dedicated on-site dispatchers.
